approval_source.question_set: Production activation v1, step A4: root controls in a production configuration

decisions.question: D07-Q01, D11-Q03
decisions.rule: A production node refuses a configuration that lacks the emergency freeze (schema 2), the upgrade policy (schema 2) or the release handover (schema 2). A production chain can always pause in an incident and move to a new release. Development builds are unchanged.
